note: Rewritten from Emerson's 1925 species-level description of Eutermes parvellus Silvestri, 1923 (type locality Kartabo, British Guiana); the original is in English and uses the old combination Nasutitermes (Subulitermes) parvellus, now placed in Araujotermes. OCR: the original gives the alate antennal length as "1.17- .138", restored from the digit count to 1.17—1.38 mm; the length with wings is printed "?.9.00-10.00"; in several measurements the 0 before the decimal point was dropped (e.g. "Total length.2.30-4.00"). The comparison sentence in the original concerns only the alates of N. microsoma and N. thompsonae.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The alate differs from N. microsoma and N. thompsonae in the relatively long hairs on the head and on the abdominal tergites.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head brown, densely covered with fine punctures, paler at the sides and around the antennae; oval; covered with rather long hairs. Fontanelle slit-shaped, about as long as the ocellus, forked at the end; muscle impressions distinct. Antennae pale, 14-segmented, segments 2, 3 and 4 equal in length, or segment 3 slightly longer than the others. Compound eyes rather large, not especially protruding, close to the lower margin of the head. Ocelli proportionally large, close to the compound eyes. Labrum pale. Postclypeus pale, with a median longitudinal line. Pronotum paler than the head, with a pale T-shaped mark in the middle; semicircular, the sides and posterior margin forming a complete arc. Posterior margins of the mesonotum and metanotum slightly concave, the sides strongly convergent. Wings pale smoky, the costa pale near the apex, the base of the radius dark. Abdominal tergites concolorous with the pronotum. Measurements: length with wings 9.00—10.00 mm; length without wings 6.00—6.50 mm; head length 0.90 mm; head width 0.73—0.77 mm; antennal length 1.17—1.38 mm; compound eye diameter 0.27 mm; pronotum length 0.33—0.40 mm; pronotum width 0.53—0.57 mm; hind tibia length 0.80 mm; forewing length 6.56—7.00 mm; forewing width 1.77—1.90 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellow, oval, plano-convex in lateral view; covered with short hairs, the hairs on the frons and vertex longer. Antennae pale, 12-segmented, segment 3 longer than segment 2, segment 2 as long as segment 4. Nasus dark, straight and slender, covered with short hairs. Pronotum pale. Abdomen pale; tergites covered with long hairs, with a row of setae on the posterior margin. Measurements: total length 2.30—4.00 mm; head length 0.95—1.03 mm; head width 0.53—0.57 mm; antennal length 0.86—1.00 mm; pronotum width 0.31 mm; hind tibia length 0.52—0.57 mm.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: The description is based on numerous alates and soldiers collected by the author from nine different colonies at Kartabo; soldiers from a single colony collected by F. M. Gaige at Dunoon, and soldiers from three colonies collected by the author in Trinidad, all agree with the Kartabo specimens. Type locality Kartabo, British Guiana; other localities Dunoon on the Potaro River and Port of Spain, Trinidad; distribution British Guiana and Trinidad.
